about: W18: opt_out none carries the no_opt_out warning and never blocks

warnings.rule: no_opt_out: opt_out is none, so this email offers no way to opt out
warnings.message: no_opt_out: opt_out is none, so this email offers no way to opt out
warnings.hint: Set opt_out to link or line: an email without a way to opt out invites spam complaints, which hurt the Mailbox's delivery.
